title: PLL with Feed Forward
text: Compute position and angular frequency from orthogonal sinusoidal signals, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Position unit} sets Unit of position output; {Enable input normalization} enables block to normalize inputs, {Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)} sets the option to enable input port to accept computed, {Position output} sets the type of position output, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Frequency ratio} sets the ratio of frequencies of output and input, {Maximum application frequency (Hz)} sets the maximum applicable input frequency, {Cutoff frequency for output filter (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency of lowpass filter, {Number of data points for lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array, {Proportional (P)} sets the proportional controller gain, {Integral (I)} sets the integral controller gain, {Position data type} sets the data type of position, {Frequency unit} sets the unit of angular frequency output, {Frequency data type} sets the data type of angular frequency output and {Table data type} sets the data type of sine-cosine lookup table. Values come from the instance.
